entries.title: Colossians 3:1
segments: If then ye were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

entries.title: Colossians 3:2
segments: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are upon the earth.

entries.title: Colossians 3:3
segments: For ye died, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

entries.title: Colossians 3:4
segments: When Christ, [who is] our life, shall be manifested, then shall ye also with him be manifested in glory.

entries.title: Colossians 3:5
segments: Put to death therefore your members which are upon the earth: fornication, uncleanness, passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry;

entries.title: Colossians 3:6
segments: for which things' sake cometh the wrath of God upon the sons of disobedience:

entries.title: Colossians 3:7
segments: wherein ye also once walked, when ye lived in these things;

entries.title: Colossians 3:8
segments: but now do ye also put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, railing, shameful speaking out of your mouth:

entries.title: Colossians 3:9
segments: lie not one to another; seeing that ye have put off the old man with his doings,

entries.title: Colossians 3:10
segments: and have put on the new man, that is being renewed unto knowledge after the image of him that created him:

entries.title: Colossians 3:11
segments: where there cannot be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondman, freeman; but Christ is all, and in all.

entries.title: Colossians 3:12
segments: Put on therefore, as God's elect, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, meekness, longsuffering;

entries.title: Colossians 3:13
segments: forbearing one another, and forgiving each other, if any man have a complaint against any; even as the Lord forgave you, so also do ye:

entries.title: Colossians 3:14
segments: and above all these things [put on] love, which is the bond of perfectness.

entries.title: Colossians 3:15
segments: And let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, to the which also ye were called in one body; and be ye thankful.

entries.title: Colossians 3:16
segments: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms [and] hymns [and] spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts unto God.

entries.title: Colossians 3:17
segments: And whatsoever ye do, in word or in deed, [do] all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

entries.title: Colossians 3:18
segments: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

entries.title: Colossians 3:19
segments: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.

entries.title: Colossians 3:20
segments: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this is well-pleasing in the Lord.

entries.title: Colossians 3:21
segments: Fathers, provoke not your children, that they be not discouraged.

entries.title: Colossians 3:22
segments: Servants, obey in all things them that are your masters according to the flesh; not with eye-service, as men-pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing the Lord:

entries.title: Colossians 3:23
segments: whatsoever ye do, work heartily, as unto the Lord, and not unto men;

entries.title: Colossians 3:24
segments: knowing that from the Lord ye shall receive the recompense of the inheritance: ye serve the Lord Christ.

entries.title: Colossians 3:25
segments: For he that doeth wrong shall receive again for the wrong that he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
